title: Champions of Kamigawa: card flavor text

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane of humans, spirits (kami), kitsune, nezumi, ogres, orochi and akki, torn by the Kami War.

entities.name: The Kami War
entities.description: War in which the kami turned against mortals across Kamigawa.

entities.name: General Takeno
entities.description: Human general who leads the defense against the kami and found the Oathkeeper.

entities.name: Isamaru, Hound of Konda
entities.description: Takeno's faithful hound.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: A lord whom Takeno, Hisoka and Masako serve or advise.

entities.name: Masako the Humorless
entities.description: Konda's servant whose icy gaze keeps others dutiful.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: A monk master of Jukai Forest whose body withers from the hate the kami return for his prayers.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: A kitsune whose teachings are quoted.

entities.name: Snow-Fur
entities.description: A kitsune poet.

entities.name: Sensei Hisoka
entities.description: Minamo School sensei who advises against the war and writes to Lord Konda.

entities.name: Lady Azami
entities.description: Minamo wizard who recommends destroying all shrines of the kami.

entities.name: Meloku the Clouded Mirror
entities.description: A Soratami who loved his cities in the clouds.

entities.name: Sensei Golden-Tail
entities.description: A sensei quoted on warriors and the sun kami.

entities.name: Hayato
entities.description: A master sailor.

entities.name: Kiku, Night's Flower
entities.description: An assassin of Takenuma Swamp who animates enemies' shadows against them.

entities.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
entities.description: A monk who writes a diary.

entities.name: Seshiro the Anointed
entities.description: An orochi whose family first reached out to the human monks.

entities.name: Sachi, Daughter of Seshiro
entities.description: Orochi shaman, daughter of Seshiro.

entities.name: Ku-Ku
entities.description: An akki poet.

entities.name: Hoto
entities.description: A temple guardian whose last words were to Jiro.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A nezumi who united three gangs by killing their leaders in a night, now called first lord.

entities.name: Split-Tail
entities.description: Old nezumi who stole scrolls from the Minamo School four generations ago.

entities.name: Oku-Doku
entities.description: An akki curse-caster whose spell failed to kill.

entities.name: Ben-Ben, Akki Hermit
entities.description: An akki some think a trickster kami in disguise.

entities.name: Kumano
entities.description: A figure rumored to hold the secret of defeating the kami and who reluctantly joined the war.

entities.name: Iname
entities.description: A spirit with death and life aspects, cycling between joy and mourning.

entities.name: Horobi, Death's Wail
entities.description: A kami risen from the ashes of Reito, who came at every battle.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: Town destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Castle where no kami has set foot; contains the Palace of Infinite Halls.

entities.name: Takenuma Swamp
entities.description: Horrifying swamp of rotting bamboo.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Forest of secrets where Dosan's monks live.

entities.name: Minamo School
entities.description: A school of wizards who understood the veil between worlds.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits who turned on the material world in the Kami War.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: Rat folk, some skilled in samurai arts and sold as ronin.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Goblin-like folk fond of rocks and pranks.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Malevolent beings revered by ogres.

entities.name: Ogres
entities.description: Ogres who worshipped oni.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake folk with shamans and warriors.

entities.name: Kitsune
entities.description: Fox folk who lead rites of purification.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Cloud-dwelling people.

entities.name: Shizo, Death's Storehouse
entities.description: Once a field of wildflowers, now a haunted moor.

events.summary: The town of Reito is destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War.
events.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

events.summary: Takeno rallies troops at the Battle of Akagi River.
events.quote: The day is not over yet,

events.summary: Takeno warns his men that the kami are coming, calming Isamaru.
events.quote: Alert the men. The kami are coming.

events.summary: Takeno tells recruits they are not yet samurai and must defend their homes.
events.quote: Defend your homes with honor, die for your cause, and perhaps then you will be worthy of the word.

events.summary: Takeno stands alone untouched by despair and rallies the army.
events.quote: General Takeno alone was not touched by despair.

events.summary: Spirits of weapons turn against great warriors in the first days of the war.
events.quote: Many great warriors died in the first days of the war

events.summary: Kami at Reito crush the militia and minor kami consume what remained.
events.quote: When the rampaging kami at Reito had crushed the opposing militia, swarms of minor kami swept over the battlefield to consume all that remained.

events.summary: Horobi, a new kami, rises from the ashes of Reito and comes at every battle.
events.quote: From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami.

events.summary: Humans escape three legions of kami at Ganzan Pass.
events.quote: The untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami

events.summary: Only Eiganjo Castle stands after the kami strike.
events.quote: Only Eiganjo Castle remained standing, glistening untouched in the sun.

events.summary: Lady Azami recommends destroying all shrines of the kami.
events.quote: I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami.

events.summary: Hisoka advises Konda against the war because it cannot be won.
events.quote: I advise against this war.

events.summary: Hisoka tells Konda there can be no victory if kami of the soul rise against mortals.
events.quote: There can be no victory in this war.

events.summary: Takeno recalls forces from Takenuma Swamp because of daily losses to kami attacks.
events.quote: We are recalling all forces from the Takenuma Swamp.

events.summary: Takeno finds the Oathkeeper in the bamboo marshes, drawing scavengers.
events.quote: After General Takeno found the Oathkeeper amidst the bamboo marshes

events.summary: A lost battalion is trapped by blizzards and starving, sending a final message to Takeno.
events.quote: We are trapped.

events.summary: The Honden of Cleansing Fire is abandoned and its zubera swarm Kamigawa.
events.quote: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

events.summary: Marrow-Gnawer unites three nezumi gangs by slaying their leaders in one night.
events.quote: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night.

events.summary: Split-Tail steals scrolls from the Minamo School, leading to the first nezumi shamans.
events.quote: Four generations ago, old Split-Tail stole a bundle of scrolls from the Minamo School.

events.summary: Ogres worship oni and most settle in Takenuma.
events.quote: Most were drawn to the darkness of Takenuma.

events.summary: Ogres free oni through blood rituals.
events.quote: who freed terrifying oni to wander Kamigawa unhindered.

events.summary: Akki find ancient items of power and begin the Three Days of Fun.
events.quote: a band of akki discovered a cache of ancient items of power.

events.summary: Dosan continues his prayers even as kami hatred slowly kills him.
events.quote: Though the kami are slowly killing him, still he continues his prayers.

events.summary: The kumo attack the monks' shrine, beginning the six-year Battle of Silk.
events.quote: Thus began the Battle of Silk, which would last six years.

events.summary: Orochi warrior youths begin to question their agreement with the monks.
events.quote: some warrior youths began questioning that agreement.

events.summary: Hoto's last words as a kami attacks Jiro near home.
events.quote: The kami would never attack us this close to home

events.summary: After 891 samurai died in one battle, Shizo became a haunted moor.
events.quote: After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

relations.quote: General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda
General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru
what she saw, Lord Konda would hear.
Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka
The Kami War drove many members of Konda's court insane.
